description: This file defines a factory function to create CRUD controllers for Mongoose models, including in-memory micro-caching for list endpoints, error handling, and various CRUD operations.

methods.name: microGet
methods.description: Retrieve a cached list response if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: microSet
methods.description: Cache a list response with a TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey
methods.description: Construct a cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError
methods.description: Map Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP failure responses.

methods.name: buildCrudController
methods.description: Main factory function that returns a CRUD controller object with list, getById, create, update, and remove methods.
